name: Fuentelencina (Spain)
description: Two equal vertical stripes, the hoist red with a blue wavy fess edged white and the fly white with a green eradicated holm oak.
history: The arms of Fuentelencina were approved in 2001 and the flag was made official in 2005, published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha on 2 May 2005; the flag is of 2:3, composed of two equal vertical stripes, the hoist red with a blue wave edged white and the fly white with a green holm oak.

features.role: wavy fess edged white on the red
